title: Turnkey 132kV Substation Deployment
scope: Design, engineering, and commissioning of a turnkey 132kV industrial substation, including transformers, HT panels, and lightning systems.
challenges: The site was located in a coastal region with high risk of salt-water corrosion and high groundwater levels.
solutions: Used hot-dip galvanized steel structures and weatherproof IP65 cabinets. Applied water-tight seals at all cable entries.
results: Substation was successfully charged 30 days ahead of schedule, enabling the factory to start operations without delay.

title: Automotive Factory Power Synchronization
scope: Installation of Motor Control Centers (MCC), dual-input switchboards, automatic PLC systems, and copper busbar routing.
challenges: Assembly lines could not tolerate power cuts. Modifications had to be finished within a short 48-hour weekend shutdown.
solutions: Pre-fabricated all panels and performed extensive testing offsite. Onsite assembly was plug-and-play.
results: Successfully completed the grid update within 48 hours. The system achieved a 99.8% energy-efficiency rating.

title: Hospital Emergency Power Setup
scope: Commissioning of automatic generator changeover panels (AMF), isolated medical panels, and chemical earthing systems.
challenges: Life support and MRI machines require continuous power. Generator backup had to start within 8 seconds of mains failure.
solutions: Configured automatic changeover breakers controlled by high-speed PLC logic and installed chemical earthing.
results: Tested backup switchover takes only 5.4 seconds, keeping critical life-support equipment completely safe.
